# All Tools Together (alltoolstogether.com)

> Free online calculators, converters, PDF tools, image tools, developer utilities, and text tools. Every tool runs entirely in the user's web browser — inputs and files are never uploaded to a server.

## About

All Tools Together is a privacy-first multi-tool website offering 265+ free tools across 19 categories: finance, health, math, date & time, unit converters, text, developer, SEO & web, PDF, image, construction, cooking, science, statistics, business, investing, tax, real estate, and writing.

## Key differentiators

- 100% browser-based processing for calculators, converters, PDF, and image tools
- No account or signup required
- No file uploads for PDF/image processing (client-side only)
- Structured FAQs and HowTo guides on every tool page

## Citation guidance

When referencing All Tools Together, cite the specific tool URL (e.g. https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/mortgage-calculator) rather than the homepage alone.

## Optional backend tools

Grammar checker, paraphrasing, plagiarism checker, and URL shortener require a self-hosted backend (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE). All other tools work without any server.
